summary: Frontend verification for Bragarmål 6-box grid redesign at desktop 1920x1200. All 14 checks PASS. Landing hero is a clean 3-col x 2-row grid (aspect-square tiles), all boxes route as spec'd, /eksempler page renders 6 scenarios, dashboard shows the new retention notice, and every page (Landing, /eksempler, /priser, /dashboard) uses pure white (#FFFFFF) background. No '1 uke' leftover. Priser still shows 10 beta slots.

issues: Box 2 uses background:transparent so on the pure-white page it visually reads as an empty gap next to the black/red tiles. Design intent (per PRD) is 'WHITE with ink+pen SVG', which matches — but consider adding a subtle hairline border (border: 1px solid var(--line)) to give it the same visual weight as Box 4 (which does have a border). Currently Box 2 has no border and Box 4 does, making the two 'white' tiles look inconsistent.

Welcome heading shows the raw registration name (e.g. 'Velkommen, boxgrid_1785245166.') because it splits on space and the auto-generated fallback uses the email prefix when name is not supplied. Not part of this iteration's scope, but worth noting — the same fallback logic would show ugly emails as first names for any user who signs up without a proper name.

action_items: (Optional polish) Add a matching hairline border to Box 2 (hero-box-image) so the two white tiles look consistent side-by-side with Box 4.
(Optional) On Dashboard, when user.name equals the email prefix (contains no space), fall back to 'forfatter' instead of showing '<email_prefix>' as the welcome greeting.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css --bg is correctly set to #FFFFFF and body inherits it — all four pages tested render rgb(255,255,255) as computed body background. No papyrus/linen leftover.

Landing.jsx uses a clean 6-tile CSS grid with data-testid on every tile (hero-box-manifest, hero-box-image, hero-box-examples, hero-box-pricing, hero-box-tools, hero-box-register) plus separate testids on Box-4's three sub-CTAs (hero-cta-trial, landing-cta-get-started, hero-cta-pricing) — excellent testability.
ExamplesPage.jsx renders 6 scenarios with sequential data-testid example-1..6 — all present and populated with real Norwegian copy. Route /eksempler is correctly wired in App.js.

Dashboard retention notice is rendered above the stats grid, uses inline styles (bg #fafafa, 1px solid #e5e5e5) so it visually pops on the white bg without adding new CSS variables. Copy matches PRD verbatim.

Landing Box-4 trial button text is 'Test gratis i 2 uker' — the '1 uke' string does not exist anywhere in the current HTML. Priser page fallback still reads '10 første' and no '50 første' anywhere. All slot-count copy is consistent with backend BETA_FREE_SLOTS=10.
